audit.whatIsWrong: Both layers gave Levels 3, 4-5 and First item to Akali and Level 2 to Skill, against the packet chart (Sett on rows 0-5, Akali only at 2+ items), the 52.77% win rate over 3136 games, and the content-layer whys text sitting directly under those rows.
audit.why: whys[1] through whys[5] all describe Sett winning ('Level 2 stays yours', 'Level 3 you still walk her down', 'First item you out-brawl her'), so the tokens contradicted their own explanations.
audit.corrected: Chart set to Sett / Sett / Sett / Sett / Sett / Sett / Akali in both layers, proposed as one atomic group of matched phases[N].side + win[N] pairs with ratings and whys aligned.

audit.whatIsWrong: Spikes and phase prose named her tools but gave no numbers, so 'all-in when her W is down' had no window attached.
audit.why: Twilight Shroud is 20/19/18/17/16s, Shuriken Flip 16/14.5/13/11.5/10s, Perfect Execution 120/90/60s, and Five Point Strike costs 110 energy at rank 1 — the energy cost, not a cooldown, is what caps her early poke.
audit.corrected: Rank-1 numbers for Shroud (20s), Shuriken Flip (16s), Perfect Execution (120s) and the 110-energy Q cost written into the Level 2-5 phases and the don'ts.

audit.whatIsWrong: Two interactions were absent: Perfect Execution's recast is an execute on a missing-HP threshold, and her combo opens with an Assassin's Mark auto-attack reset rather than an ability cast.
audit.why: Akali's R carries the execute flag and her passive the autoReset flag; a player watching for the ability cast reacts one auto too late, and a player watching the health bar instead of the threshold number dies at a percentage he thought was safe.
audit.corrected: Execute threshold stated in phases[4].why and dontsFull[1].d; the Assassin's Mark reset tell stated in spikes[2].text.

audit.whatIsWrong: dosFull[2] was titled 'Build MR' but its body text was a copy of the generic 'she wasted Shroud, commit' line — the do said nothing about MR.
audit.why: Akali's damage is magic; Mercury's Treads is already the listed boot, so the resistance advice belongs in the body.
audit.corrected: dosFull[2].d now names Mercury's Treads and Spirit Visage and why MR holds against her.

edits.before: Q gives move speed toward Akali and two empowered punches. Take short Q trades and back off before she can answer with Twilight Shroud.
edits.after: Knuckle Down's move speed closes on her and Five Point Strike costs 110 energy at rank 1 — she cannot poke you off, so take the trade every wave.

edits.before: Facebreaker is online — the E-stun into double punch + W is your full pattern. Run it the moment Akali burns Twilight Shroud.
edits.after: Facebreaker is online at 16s and she has no dash until Shuriken Flip — stun her off the wave and cash the double punch into Haymaker.

edits.before: Q ranks make your punch trades heavier, but Akali has her core tools too. Keep the grit bar honest: trade in, W-shield her return damage, out.
edits.after: Shuriken Flip is her only reposition and it is 16s at rank 1. Trade the moment she flips out — punch, Facebreaker, and cash the Grit you banked.

edits.before: The Show Stopper online — you can start fights Akali doesn't want. Suplex her into your wave or tower, never into her own minions.
edits.after: The Show Stopper suppresses her mid-dash. Perfect Execution's recast executes on missing HP — leave above that number, not after one more auto.

edits.before: Stridebreaker fixes your only weakness — sticking to Akali. Shove, recall on the spike, and force the next trade before she matches your item.
edits.after: Stridebreaker fixes your only weakness — sticking to Akali through Shroud. Her one-item burst still cannot kill you through a full-Grit Haymaker.

edits.before: Sterak's makes your all-in nearly unburstable. Fights are decided by whether you cash a max-grit W — track Twilight Shroud and commit on the gap.
edits.after: Two items and she deletes you before Haymaker lands. Mercury's Treads into Spirit Visage, hold Facebreaker for her Shuriken Flip in, and never fight her alone.

edits.before: Akali wastes Twilight Shroud — commit the full pattern immediately.
edits.after: Mercury's Treads then Spirit Visage — her damage is magic, so MR holds.

edits.before: That is Akali's favourite window — refuse it and half her win condition is gone.
edits.after: Shroud is 20s at rank 1 — walk to its edge, wait the reveal, then Facebreaker.

edits.before: Burning your answer for tiny value leaves you naked for its full cooldown.
edits.after: Perfect Execution is 120s at rank 1 — with no MR its recast simply executes you.

edits.before: With Gunblade or Rocketbelt Akali's burst spikes and she'll dodge your W with Shroud timing. Bank Grit before you commit; a full-Grit W Haymaker chunks her squishy HP and your P heals the trade back.
edits.after: With Gunblade or Rocketbelt her burst spikes and she'll dodge Haymaker with Shroud timing. Her combo opens on an Assassin's Mark auto reset -- step back on that wind-up, not the Q. Bank Grit, then cash Haymaker.

notes: The level chart was wrong on four of seven rows in BOTH layers at once — they agreed with each other and disagreed with the packet, the win rate and their own whys text, so no mirror check would have caught it. As the mirror audit also noted, Sett's kit file flags The Show Stopper as 'grounding' but Riot's description says only carry, slam, damage and a landing slow; I wrote nothing claiming it denies Shuriken Flip or Perfect Execution.
